Uterine fibroids are one of the common causes of heavy menstrual bleeding, prolonged periods, clots, pelvic pressure, and weakness due to anemia.

The type and location of fibroids matter. Some fibroids grow inside the uterine cavity, some within the uterine wall, and some outside the uterus. This is why proper evaluation and fibroid mapping are important before deciding treatment.
